summary: After the threat: Someone has threatened or attacked your household after {your stand}, and {household member} asks what now.
realLife: In 1962, days after she tried to register, shots were fired into the home where she was staying. She and her family left for about three months, then came back and kept organizing.
gates: A threat or attack on your household is on record (never authored).
choices: send the family to stay with relatives for a while
stay and go to the police
step back from the cause or the race
